# OSD Apparels

> OSD Apparels is an apparel manufacturer and garment exporter in Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan, serving private label brands and international buyers.

OSD Apparels supports knitted and woven garments, sampling, custom branding, production, and export coordination. The website describes a minimum order of 50 pieces per style. Confirm pricing, lead times, and order-specific requirements with the company.

## Company

- [Home](https://osdapparels.com/): Custom clothing manufacturing and export overview.
- [About](https://osdapparels.com/about): Company background and manufacturing approach.
- [Contact](https://osdapparels.com/contact): Enquiries and current contact details.
- [Reviews](https://osdapparels.com/testimonials): Published client testimonials.

## Products and services

- [Products](https://osdapparels.com/products): Knitted and woven apparel categories.
- [Menswear](https://osdapparels.com/products/mens): Shirts, hoodies, jackets, denim, co-ord sets, activewear, and loungewear.
- [Kidswear](https://osdapparels.com/products/kids): Children's clothing, school uniforms, activewear, and matching sets.
- [Services](https://osdapparels.com/services): Sourcing, sampling, garment production, and export support.
- [Custom orders](https://osdapparels.com/custom-order): Private label and OEM development, printing, embroidery, sizing, and packaging.
- [How it works](https://osdapparels.com/how-it-works): Enquiry, sampling, production, quality control, and delivery.
- [Request a quote](https://osdapparels.com/quote): Submit manufacturing requirements.
